push.title: D 2-2 vs Vaine Saxxxx | You: 8.9 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 3rd best match performance of the season, BellyTb1. An 8.9. That's the stuff.

THE GOOD
+ Shots on target 7, up from your usual 2. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Man of the Match, your 11th for us. You carried the moment and carried us.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season, at 8.9. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 3. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ On-ball actions 44, up from your usual 32. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 2 goals from 7 on target. Mind this: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. Water the plant.
- Won 1 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 52%). Easy win: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike. Bread and butter.
- Partners in crime on tackle timing, you and buddskees. Partners in the fix too: one presses, one covers.
- A promotion match, and we drew it. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 29 (best was buddskees's 40). Golden rule: Drop between the lines to link play, then spin in behind once it goes wide.

Skills corner: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.

Last thing, BellyTb1. The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs Vaine Saxxxx | You: 7.6 (4th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.6. That's your 4th best match performance of the season. Honest football.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ Your passes to BellyTb1 had perfect weight and perfect timing.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (27 vs their best 13). More of that, please and thank you.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (1). I see you, and I like what I see.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. Nice piece of business.

THE BAD
- 73% passing (27 of 37, down from your usual 86%). Simple as pie: With your back to goal, shield it and set it back to the runner facing play. Turning into traffic is a coin flip. Habits beat highlights.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.6 (best was BellyTb1's 8.9). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- A promotion match, and we drew it. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 7). Next rep: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- Shots: 1. Aim for 3+.

Practice plan: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

Progress over perfection. - Coach Lasso
